name: Coins of Fortune

features.name: Dragon Nudge
features.description: Three matching symbols on a reel reveal a dragon wild.

features.name: Lucky Respins
features.description: Scatters walk left and are collected as they exit.

review:
An early, Asian-themed Nolimit game. Land three matching symbols on one reel and Dragon Nudge reveals a stacked dragon wild there and respins the rest.

Three or more scatters start Lucky Respins, where scatters walk left each spin and get collected as they leave the reels. Medium volatility, 6,015x max and 96.48% RTP. Gentle and easy to read – good for a calm session.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
